scenario: `cooldown 0_s` is legal per LCDB.5.6 / LCDB.7.6 / LGRA.6.6.7 — degenerate but not an error. The rate-allow gate emits as usual; the runtime treats a 0-window tracker as always-permitting. Pins compile_ok against the spec; companion to CMP-055 / CMP-145 (positive windows).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r cooldown 0_s:
    Trig
->
    log info "x"
